user.title: HeatWrite
user.description: Adds write access on top of the Wolf SmartSet Service integration. Credentials are taken from there — no input required.

abort.wolflink_missing: The Wolf SmartSet Service (wolflink) integration is not set up. Please add it first.
abort.wolflink_not_loaded: The Wolf SmartSet Service integration is configured but not loaded. Check that it starts without errors.

data.history_limit: Entries kept in the change history

data_description.history_limit: Older entries are dropped. The history lives in .storage and survives restarts.
data_description.max_writes_per_hour: Guards against automation loops and EEPROM wear. Every written parameter goes into the BM-2's EEPROM, which has a finite number of write cycles.
data_description.scan_interval: Only parameters with an enabled entity are read. Settings rarely change, and every read goes through the unofficial Wolf cloud.

set_value.name: Write value
set_value.description: Writes a parameter by its value_id. Unchecked — a typo hits a different parameter.

value_id.name: value_id
value_id.description: Parameter ID, exposed as an attribute on every entity.

system_id.name: System ID
system_id.description: Only needed with more than one Wolf system.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Reports what would happen without writing.

force.name: Force
force.description: Writes even when the parameter is reported read-only or the value is unchanged.

set_by_name.name: Write value by name
set_by_name.description: Like Write value, but addressed by parameter name. Aborts if the name is ambiguous.

name.name: Parameter name
name.description: Exactly as shown in the entity list.

system_id.name: System ID
system_id.description: Only needed with more than one Wolf system.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Reports what would happen without writing.

force.name: Force
force.description: Writes even when the parameter is reported read-only.

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Reverts the most recent changes by writing back the previous values.

snapshot_create.name: Create snapshot
snapshot_create.description: Stores the current value of every writable parameter under a name.

snapshot.name: Name
snapshot.description: Free choice. An existing name is overwritten.

snapshot_restore.name: Restore snapshot
snapshot_restore.description: Writes back every differing value from the snapshot. Creates a snapshot of the current state first.

reload_parameters.name: Reload parameters
reload_parameters.description: Re-reads the parameter list without restarting Home Assistant.
